page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title lines from top to bottom, then an engraving of a palm tree with two banners, then the imprint lines at the foot. No margin text.

main_text.l: S. S. Literarum in Academia Groning-Omlandica Professoris,
Commentarii Theorico-Practici in loca quædam selecta Veteris Testamenti.
Parallelismi quidam Vaticiniorum ex Veteri Testamento in Novo citatorum.
Excudit GERARDUS BORSTIUS, cIↄ Iↄc Lxxxv.

page.notes: The engraving shows a palm tree with two banners reading "UT PALMA" and "VIRESCIT". Handwritten shelf mark "Wb 71 285" below the imprint is not transcribed. Date in the imprint is MDCLXXXV (1685).
